description: Verify that TCP in LISTEN sends a RST after receiving a segment carrying an unacceptable ACK (RFC 793 §3.4 p36)
approach:
[Objective]
In LISTEN, a segment carrying any ACK is suspicious — there's no connection to ack. DUT must reply RST. Two phases test SYN,ACK and bare ACK shapes.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Phase 1: tester sends SYN,ACK → DUT replies RST.
3. Phase 2: tester sends bare ACK → DUT replies RST.

[Pass condition]
Both phases produce DUT RST.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_phase<n> — no DUT RST in phase n

verdicts.Pass: DUT replied RST to unacceptable-ACK in LISTEN (both shapes) — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase1: No DUT RST to LISTEN SYN,ACK
verdicts.Fail_timeout_phase2: No DUT RST to LISTEN naked ACK
